import sys
from collections import Counter

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        print(-1)
        return
    
    n = int(data[0])
    arr = list(map(int, data[1:n+1]))
    k = int(data[n+1])
    
    freq = Counter(arr)
    unique_elements = [x for x in arr if freq[x] == 1]
    
    if len(unique_elements) < k:
        print(-1)
        return
    
    unique_elements.sort()
    print(unique_elements[k-1])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
